# DEcoDLE

> A daily word puzzle that gates every guess behind a rhythm round. Players clear an Acoustic Cypher — a beat-matching round on a radial symbol dial — to earn each guess attempt. Released April 24, 2026 on iOS and Android by Ad Astra Vanguard Studios LLC. Free with optional $2.99 PRO upgrade.

DEcoDLE is the first release from Ad Astra Vanguard Studios. The patent-pending Pinwheel + Cypher mechanic (USPTO provisional filings #64/037,214 and #64/061,463, both 2026) combines a Wordle-style five-position deduction puzzle with a rhythm gate. Eight-symbol alphabet, five-position hidden sequence, up to six guess attempts. Three modes (Daily, Endless, Challenge) and three difficulty tiers (Casual, Hard, Expert). The top in-game grade — FLAWLESS.EXE — is reachable only through a perfect-timing run.

## Companion novella

- [DEcoDLE: The Journal Logs (Kindle)](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GX31SKMM/): Epistolary novel set in the DEcoDLE universe — a correspondence between two in-game AI characters, :/AI+> and :/System>. Releases June 12, 2026.
- [@DEcoDLE_app on X](https://x.com/DEcoDLE_app): Duolog drip-cast — six-week serialized rollout of the novella, Monday–Thursday, five threads per day, May 4 – June 11, 2026.
